title: RENAME COLUMN in place on a live table
expected_feedback: Standard: the database side is trivial — RENAME COLUMN has been supported since Oracle 9i Release 2 and is metadata-only with a brief lock, independent of the 18M row count. Do not report it as unsupported or as needing a rewrite. The risk is on the application side and it is the inverse of the usual migration hazard: the statement completes in milliseconds, auto-commits, and every deployed query referencing usr_id begins failing with ORA-00904 at that moment. There is no dual-name grace period and no transaction to roll back. Use expand/contract — add user_id, dual-write, backfill, cut reads over, then SET UNUSED the old column — or put a view in front of the table exposing both spellings during the transition.
